study.title: Crop and Weed Classification Using Pixel-wise Segmentation on Ground and Aerial Images
study.short_title: Crop and Weed Classification Using Pixel-wise Segmentation on Ground and Aerial Images

dataset.name: UAV1 (sugar beet field, multispectral NIR/Red + NDVI); supplementary UAV2 (corn field); SugarBeets, Stuttgart, Carrots, Sunflowers (non-UAV)
dataset.note: UAV1 = 155 multispectral images; 100 used for augmentation (420 augmented) + 55 held out for testing. Labels: soil, crop, weed.

mIoU.ambiguity: European decimal comma notation; 3-class (soil/crop/weed) multi-channel VGG-UNet on SugarBeets test split.

mPA.quote: The best results was achieved using the three channels together as input, while for pixel-wise segmentation into soil, and plant sugar beet dataset the best result for NDVI channel. ... RED+NIR+NDVI 0.95 0.98 0.88
mPA.ambiguity: Mean accuracy (avg. per-class accuracy) for 3-class segmentation on the UAV sugar beet dataset with RED+NIR+NDVI input.

fps.ambiguity: Paper reports per-image processing time 0.6 s, not FPS.

latency_ms.quote: The performance of VGG-UNet architecture has been tested on an embedded GPU board, namely Jetson TX2, and the processing time per image was 0.6 [s]
latency_ms.ambiguity: Stated as processing time per image (0.6 s) on Jetson TX2.
